patches.description: Complete PQ-Migrate research adaptation, including early R1 rejection, pre-T gates, single/batch proof paths, active boundary regressions and pool policy.

Test-only corrections from the 2026-11-10 heavy validation: core tests pass params.Rules to StateDB.Finalise/IntermediateRoot, and the final-state and pre-T pool enrollment fixtures give the Registry the code 0x00 and nonce 1 it holds from T0 on (installed by the T0 transition block, or held by the genesis allocation when T0 is at or before the genesis time), so EIP-158 finalization keeps its records.

Pool reset stamps a sponsor's held batches by sponsor, sponsor nonce and hash instead of map order, in pruneBatchReset and in Reset's state-unavailable branch, so their retries run in nonce order (two regression tests); PQ-Migrate copyright lines on pqpool.go and reorg.go and attached package doc comments.

Start-up check S8: when T0 is at or before the genesis timestamp and no state bridge is configured, the node refuses to start unless the genesis state holds code 0x00 and nonce 1 at the Registry and the FactRegistry (read from the genesis trie, or from the stored allocation checked against the genesis root); tests for vectors TB-5 to TB-9 and for the node start path.

RPC replays (debug tracing, debug_intermediateRoots, debug_standardTraceBlockToFile, debug_replayBadBlock, eth_simulateV1) run the PQ block prologue before the system calls, as import does; tests compare replays of a T0 transition block with the importer and cover the prologue's refusal. Notice date updated.

Gate fixture tests: internal/pqtest loads the second public four-owner C fixture (one early expiry, fee modes 3 and 1, one migration nonce 1) with the sponsor window at the latest expiry, and a two-block core import test carries a real 0x7d by the fourth owner's public legacy key and then the batch, asserting the end-to-end expiry skip 0x0201, the owner-money settlement of fee modes 3 and 1 with native C acceptance, the override of the reachable ENROLLED record with was_override, and the gas formula; the modification inventory lists the two files.
